description: Player 1's deck for spec 21 (SPEC §10.10, R277, R279, R280): #31 KY's Math Equation (its formula's value, {1} at cost 1, rides on it in hand), #65 Masochism Mask (Quickdraw, so it is always in the opening hand; its text names Spikey Pillow, a reference) and #26 Glowy Jelly Bean (3 mana: it makes the Math Equation Radiant in hand, whose face then marks cost+3 in gold and reads {3}). The other seventeen are 08-do-nothing-a's cards without #55, #66 and #100, plus #88: every one costs 3 or more and asks nothing, so nothing resolves that the spec does not play. With seed 21-marks-163 player 1 holds KY's Math Equation, Glowy Jelly Bean and Masochism Mask on its first turn, and has the 3 mana Glowy Jelly Bean costs on its third (player-turn 5).
